name: @flashylabs/wdk-capability-audit
description: Scan a project's node_modules for installed @tetherto/wdk-* packages and report what chains each declares — mainnet, testnet, or unknown, against a small hand-maintained registry of chain identifiers this package is confident are real. Never guesses at a chain it doesn't recognize, and refuses rather than emitting an empty report that looks clean.

scripts.test: node --test test/audit.test.mjs test/cli.test.mjs test/discover.test.mjs test/faucets.test.mjs test/inspect.test.mjs test/manifest.test.mjs test/registry.test.mjs test/report.test.mjs test/schema-validate.test.mjs test/strike.test.mjs test/test-script.test.mjs test/workflow-pins.test.mjs
scripts.version: npm run manifest && git add wdk-capability-audit.manifest.json

author: Flashy Labs
